key.name: render-delay
key.description: Delay before re-rendering after typing stops

key.name: layout-engine
key.description: Graphviz layout engine (dot, neato, fdp, sfdp, circo, twopi)

key.name: recent-files
key.description: List of recently opened file paths

key.name: max-recent-files
key.description: Maximum number of recent files to remember

key.name: split-orientation
key.description: Orientation of the editor/preview split (horizontal or vertical)

key.name: drill-down-patterns
key.description:
Templates used by the drill-down navigation to find a related file when the user double-clicks an element. $alias is replaced with the clicked element's identifier; $base is replaced with the current file's basename (without extension). Patterns are tried in order; the first existing file wins.
Patterns containing a forward slash are treated as relative paths from the source directory (e.g. 'containers/$alias.puml').

key.name: drill-down-subdirs
key.description: Subdirectories under the source file's directory that the drill-down navigation also searches for matching files. Each subdirectory is searched with all the drill-down-patterns.

key.name: color-scheme-follow-system
key.summary: Follow system theme for diagram colors
key.description: When true, the active color preset switches automatically between color-scheme-light and color-scheme-dark based on the libadwaita system theme. When false, color-scheme-light is always used.

key.name: color-scheme-light
key.description: Built-in palette id used when the system is in light mode. Valid values: default-light, default-dark, solarized-light, solarized-dark, dracula, nord-light, nord-dark.

key.name: color-scheme-dark
key.description: Built-in palette id used when the system is in dark mode.

key.name: custom-palette-overrides
key.description: JSON object mapping Palette slot names to hex color strings. Applied on top of the active preset. Empty string means no overrides. Example: {"background":"#111","person_fill":"#F00"}.
